geometry_source.role: Accepted damaged ship geometry, hardpoints, pivots and inherited provisional scale; 196 physical meshes retained exactly.

inherited_generation.provider: OpenAI built-in ImageGen. Exact prompt files retained in prompts; generated native images preserved without rescaling.

reference.role: Material/color/weathering direction only; no ship layout, perspective, lighting or crater geometry copied.

inherited_generation.derivation: Four lossless equal-quadrant crops: cream top-left, oxide top-right, gunmetal bottom-left, backing bottom-right. Existing 627x627 crops reused byte-for-byte; no resampling or new generation.

surface_contract.mapping: Explicit overlapping SurfaceTileUV on every mesh corner; SurfaceRestPosition and per-corner paint/patina/panel eligibility attributes. Fixed root-relative rest coordinates.
surface_contract.representation: Relightable Blender material graph, not a unique UV-packed or baked PBR texture atlas.
surface_contract.shell_finish: Bare oxide shell receives UV-cell cream and gunmetal repair batches, a dark underside keel strip and a stern service core through color and metallic response only; original outer armor roles retained.

verification.scope: Finite geometry, placement, packed image, coordinate and material graph checks; ten motion transforms. No visual acceptance claim.

review_contract.motion: Physical ship yaw 360 degrees over continuous loop; pitch +/-15 degrees; roll +/-4 degrees; camera and studio lights static.
review_contract.render_bindings: review/stills-manifest.json and review/motion-manifest.json capture ordered hashes during rendering; ignored build rig snapshots are ephemeral.
review_contract.media_receipt: review/media-validation.json: completed eight-second encode and strict decode; separate sampled visual and browser playback review in review/motion-review.json. Final cinematic style acceptance remains open.

limits: Relightable Blender material asset, not a unique packed PBR atlas. Neutral ImageGen tile RGB approximates albedo. Roughness/metal/normal are authored, not measured. Bow/stern/belly retain simpler source geometry; deep modeled craters remain starboard. No new ship design or gameplay dimensions.
